message.content: On September 20th, 2026, ThaneChambers asked LiHua about her favorite first-person shooter game. Specifically, he inquired, "Hey Li Hua! What’s your favorite first-person shooter game? I'm curious! 🎮" LiHua responded positively to this query by stating that she is particularly into "Call of Duty: Warzone," appreciating its battle royale mode as it is very fun. ThaneChambers chimed in with his own preference, mentioning that he has been playing "Apex Legends" recently, finding the characters and abilities in the game to be exciting. He then asked LiHua about her favorite aspect of "Warzone," to which she replied that she loves the strategy involved, such as planning her approach and working with teammates, and the adrenaline rush felt when she is in the final circle.
